companyIntro.name: People First Partners
companyIntro.mission: Make hiring, pay and employee relations fair, compliant and efficient.
companyIntro.culture: Fair process, accurate records. People decisions are documented and explainable.

projectBackground.name: Workforce Health Check — Halden Logistics
projectBackground.context: Turnover is rising and a grievance has been raised against a supervisor. Leadership wants facts and a fair process.

manager.name: Agnieszka Nowak
manager.role: Head of HR Partnering, People First Partners
manager.note: People problems need data and fairness. Show me the numbers and the process you will follow.

assignment.title: Diagnose and respond
assignment.brief: Calculate absence, turnover and engagement, handle a grievance fairly and write the outcome.

documents.name: Workforce Data
documents.note: 120 employees; 360 absence days; 240 working days a year.

tasks.title: Absence Rate
tasks.prompt: 360 days lost; 120 employees x 240 working days. What is the absence rate (%)?
tasks.mistake: Counting days without the base is meaningless.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Turnover
tasks.prompt: 18 leavers; average headcount 120. What is turnover (%)?
tasks.mistake: Using end headcount only skews the rate.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Engagement Score
tasks.prompt: 78 of 120 responses were positive. What is the score (%)?
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Handling a Grievance
tasks.prompt: What is the right first step for a formal grievance?
options: Acknowledge it, appoint an impartial investigator and follow the procedure
Ask the supervisor to resolve it alone
tasks.mistake: Letting the accused investigate is unfair.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Fair Investigation
tasks.prompt: Select principles of a fair investigation.
options: Decide on evidence and give reasons
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Outcome Letter
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence grievance outcome letter.
tasks.modelAnswer: Thank you for raising your grievance. An impartial manager interviewed you, the supervisor and two witnesses and reviewed the rota records. The evidence supports part of your complaint: shift changes were made without notice. We will require written notice of changes and provide coaching for the supervisor. You have the right to appeal within five working days.
tasks.reasoning: A good outcome letter states the process, findings, actions and appeal right.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Unheard Grievance
caseStudy.background: A grievance sat for two months without response. The employee resigned and claimed constructive dismissal.
caseStudy.solution: People First set a 5-day acknowledgement standard and trained managers.
